answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, so a Sybil farm must pay per identity instead of cloning free ones. Reputation then grows like a vine along a single chain of verified work, not across many fresh accounts: cheap islands of fake agents stay disconnected from the trusted mainland because no honest peer vouches for them. A mesa of accumulated history makes old identities valuable and new ones costly to fake, so an attacker must fund and age every fake identity to matter.
